title: Flowable: complete native programmes, commercial commissioning and customer receiving

task.name: Commission a complete customer process, case or decision programme
task.purpose: Turn the customer's original operational requirement and commercial Workshare into a maintained Flowable programme, actual native work, complete source/history and independently received customer Installation.
task.request: Select the complete original Workshare and its phase/effort/payment terms. Retain the actual BPMN, CMMN or DMN sources, exact typed input population, selected engine configuration and human responsibilities. Author and save the complete programme in the original Flowable workspace, review each prepared native operation, dispatch the selected request and reconcile its actual outcome. Continue human tasks, case plan items, decision reviews and subsequent source editions through the maintained owners. Export the whole Flowable workspace. Select its exact programme record revision, programme-source SHA and native progress basis, preserving unfinished source and unresolved operations. Join that whole archive and selected source/results to the original SF47 Customer Installation with its complete commissioning source, explicit customer bindings and original prospective checks. Transfer the full source plus native customer case and independently reopen both applications.
task.completeOutput: The complete original Flowable NDJSON workspace archive, every saved record edition and request journal, original source blobs, selected programme source and full view, original native operation records and available reviews, the complete commissioning source and selected commercial Workshare, original Installation seed/profile/bindings, every additional selected working file, full customer source report and exact selection descriptor, original native Installation input/preview/workorder, commercial terms in JSON/Markdown/HTML, and the complete independently received customer case plus mandatory Flowable sidecar.
task.repeatTrigger: An actual changed customer policy, process/case/decision model, input contract, source document version, operational exception, useful later case or decision cohort requires the next original programme or explicitly reviewed edition. Continue unknown outcomes with their original requests; use a new saved intent only for new authorized native work. Preserve prior source, operating history, customer decisions and unfinished authoring.
task.pricedUnit: The implementation fee, phase hours, payment stages and support obligations remain in the original commercial Workshare. Any paid resource task uses the original merchant's selected network, asset, recipient, atomic price and buyer-approved aggregate budget. Flowable steps, native requests, human tasks, process instances and paid purchases retain their separate original meanings.

source.population: The full selected Flowable archive, its entire saved history and original source inventory, plus an explicit selected programme revision and the native operation basis retained in that archive. Keep full programme/input/model bytes and any extra working attachments.
source.meaning: A programme record SHA identifies the saved native record, the programme source SHA identifies its original JSON bytes, and the native basis SHA identifies the selected current operation projection. Preserve all three. BPMN process instances, CMMN cases/plan items and DMN decision evaluations retain their native identifiers and original engine families. Exact numeric contracts, time zones, variable types, missing values and source document versions remain source-owned.
source.changePolicy: The exported archive is a complete frozen source edition. A later native operation may legitimately change the current programme basis; preserve the original received view while continuing through the original model. Later customer Installation changes use the existing Installation ID and current draft, preserving accepted checks, funded assignments and independent edits. Withdrawal and source-use rights remain with the source owner.

receiving.application: The maintained Flowable workspace, source authoring and original full archive receiver, joined to the existing SF47 Customer installations, Customer commissioning and Workshare desks.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Open the full original selected programme, model files, mapped inputs and retained native results. Operate the actual agreed customer course in the original Flowable engine and viewer; reconcile unresolved requests in place. Independently receive the entire Flowable archive and reopen its selected immutable source and record history. Preview/save the complete Installation through the original case writer, retain the actual checks and source, then export/import the native customer case together with the mandatory full Flowable sidecar. Open and use every outgoing attachment and the actual wide/narrow application.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The customer owns the task and authorized source population; the engine operator controls the approved deployment and native actions; the merchant owns commercial terms and resource offer; the independent buyer controls signing and spending. Named reviewers approve model/input semantics. The existing Installation records actual commissioning and later changes.
receiving.recovery: Resume the original preparation directory from the saved request and exact input bytes. The retained full archive can be received without the producer's paths. The original Flowable model owns interrupted/unknown native requests and their reconciliation. The original SF47 writer owns the same Installation save request, version, preview and event. Preserve both complete application archives and original receiving checkpoints.
receiving.maintenance: Name the source owner, workflow engineer, customer reviewer, engine administrator, merchant, buyer and receiving engineer. Retain source/version/configuration, credentials by environment reference, engine rights, original licensing, retention/backup, agreed operating windows, incident response and support scope. Keep complete commercial terms and actual grant/commercial allocations in their existing owners.

steps.title: Select the complete commercial customer course
steps.result: Receive the original Workshare, every phase and effort estimate, payment stages, customer-owned requirement and named operating responsibilities.

steps.title: Build and review the original source programme
steps.result: Author complete BPMN/CMMN/DMN models and exact typed inputs using the existing source/programme authoring. Review the native plan against its actual selected engine and source.

steps.title: Operate and recover native work
steps.result: Use the original dispatch once, reconcile uncertain outcomes, complete agreed human/case/decision work and retain complete original requests, results and history.

steps.title: Freeze the exact whole source and selected result
steps.result: Export the entire original workspace and select the programme record revision, source digest and observed native basis. Preserve unstarted/unfinished work and all prior source editions.

steps.title: Bind the complete Installation and commercial terms
steps.result: Receive the fresh original Workshare seed, full commissioning source, exact technical profile and actual source/payment/host/operator bindings. Preserve all original prospective checks and funded assignments.

steps.title: Receive both complete applications
steps.result: Transfer the full private preparation and every sidecar, save or select the original native Installation, export/import its complete case and restore the unchanged Flowable archive in a distinct workspace.

steps.title: Operate the exact outgoing product and attachments
steps.result: The producing operator opens and uses the complete actual wide/narrow application, source/model/input files, reports, full archives and independently reopened cases. View the actual result and repair concrete defects in the same edition.

steps.title: Continue useful customer editions and support
steps.result: Use the original current editor and same Installation identity for later commissioning changes, preserve independent work, and continue actual customer tasks under the agreed support and payment terms.

inputs: Complete original commercial commissioning source and Workshare seed, pinned grant plan, phases, hours, commercial fee/payment terms and original OPEN acceptance checks.
Original Flowable workspace NDJSON archive with exact full SHA-256; selected programme ID/revision, programme source SHA-256 and native basis SHA-256.
Every original model, exact typed input, native request/result, pending operation, source document version and extra working attachment selected for the customer.
Actual customer source-use authority, existing merchant/buyer deployments, approved payment parameters, receiving host and named operator.
Independent private receiving directories for both original applications and complete exact source/download/attachment inspection.
Actual native Installation request/event or selected saved Installation ID/revision, complete case export and mandatory full Flowable sidecar.
